name: Create a connector
description: Create a connector Create a connector and optionally link it to a project. POST /v1/connect/connectors
context:
POST /v1/connect/connectors
Create a connector and optionally link it to a project. Use `type` with complete provider data, or use `service` with `connectionMethod` so Connect can supply the type, endpoints, templates, and defaults.
Optional: teamId (query) — The team ID that scopes the request. Do not send it with slug. If both are omitted, Vercel uses the team associated with the token or the authenticated user's default team. The request returns 401 if no team can be selected.; slug (query) — The team slug that scopes the request. Do not send it with teamId. If both are omitted, Vercel uses the team associated with the token or the authenticated user's default team. The request returns 401 if no team can be selected.; body (body)
